about.title: About Me
about.name: Manzi Prince Babou
about.bio: I'm a full-stack web developer with a passion for building beautiful, functional, and scalable web applications. Currently, I'm a student at Rwanda Coding Academy, honing my skills in software development & Embedded Systems. My enthusiasm for learning new technologies and frameworks drives me to constantly expand my skill set. I'm well-versed in various languages & frameworks, and I'm excited about the prospect of delving deeper into these and other emerging technologies.

services.title: Services
services.description: Since I entered this field, I've honed my skills in problem-solving and adapting to various tech stacks. Here are the key services I offer:

list.title: Hardworking and goal-oriented
list.description: I am hardworking, committed and I like setting goals and tasks to be done so as to simplify work.

list.title: Backend Development
list.description: Proficient in building scalable and efficient backend services using Node.js, Python, and PHP. Experience with Spring Boot and Docker for containerization.

list.title: Frontend Development
list.description: Expert in creating responsive and visually appealing frontend designs using Next.js, React, Angular, and Vue. Strong understanding of UI/UX design principles.

list.title: Cybersecurity
list.description: Strong background in cybersecurity, focusing on protecting applications and systems from vulnerabilities. Experienced with various security tools and practices.

list.title: Mobile Development
list.description: Skilled in developing mobile applications using Flutter and React Native. Focused on delivering smooth and user-friendly mobile experiences.

list.title: AI & ML
list.description: Hands-on experience in AI and ML, working with Python, IoT, and Raspberry Pi. Developed and deployed machine learning models for various applications.
